newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura,DKB to be banned from Keidanren activities.
newsitem.headline: Nomura,DKB to be banned from Keidanren activities.

text.p: Keidanren chairman Shoichiro Toyoda said on Monday scandal-hit Nomura Securities Co Ltd and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd will not be allowed to engage in the business lobby's activities, such as participating and voting in committee meetings, for the next 12 months.

Asked about whether the recent payoff scandal involving the the two were isolated cases in the corporate world, he said, "Rather than saying they are isolated cases, we all must take a firm stance (against corporate racketeering)."
Asked about the yen's surge against the dollar on Monday in Tokyo, Toyoda said: "I have been saying a dollar/yen rate of 110-120 yen is desirable. Daily fluctuations of 3-4 yen are too big."
He also reiterated that exchange rate fluctuations are not desirable.
